fixes.detail: The ankle-niche rule produced 0 placements, so there are no niches along this corridor at all. Fix the rule (offset 1.9 vs ~1.5–2 m half-width, or avoid 'anchored' eating every slot) so the staggered 4–5.5 m niches appear.

The hero has no light. Add the intended warm light under/behind the falling sheet at the lip (~49,78.6, z -20.3), plus a mist-sheet emissive, so the lip is the brightest thing straight ahead from the junction.

The 1.05 m floor-lantern pair at the grotto door plus the two toro make a wall of four white blocks on the axis. Replace the pair with wall brackets at 1.8 m on the door posts (52±1.6, 82), and let the toro frame the lip.
This boulder sits at z -20.9 (top about -20.6), entirely under water and sunk below the bed. Raise it to z -20.4 like the others, or better, to a top at about -19.9.
It fills the left of the reveal frame. Move it by (+0.6,-0.4) toward the south kerb corner, so it frames the lip instead of blocking the view down the stair.

top_change: Light the spill lip and the Mist Steps below it (warm under-sheet light, landing lanterns, Kawagiri amber/magenta haze rising), so the corridor ends in a glowing drop instead of a lantern cluster in front of a dark wall.
